content:
Rae: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A  putting the concrete windows and owners here so folks can ping the right people.

Leah: API runtime v2: internal canary next Tue, partner canary ~3w after, GA ~6w after partner canary. We'll expose opt-in via header `X-Redwood-API-Version: v2` and query `?api_version=v2`. No automatic migration for pinned model versions.

Hector: Will streaming payloads change in a way that breaks current consumers?

Leah: Minor framing tweak: streaming will emit an additional partial payload for function args. Backwards-compatible for 90 days post-GA. We'll publish migration snippets and SDK PRs right after internal canary.

Nina: Console: per-route token cost, latency percentiles (p50/p90/p99), and a basic canary manager (start/pause/rollback). Internal + pilot partners beta mid-April, public opt-in beta mid-May, GA end of Q2.

Priya: Optimize timing: batching/caching advisor = internal alpha in ~2 sprints, public alpha end of month. Quantization recommender (with quality/cost deltas) targeted for Q3. We'll publish an RFC + sample eval sets before public alpha.

Hector: SDK changes timeline? We need to bump deps in several services.

Nina: SDKs (py/js) will add a `partial_function_args` event to `client.stream()` callbacks. Expect PRs within 48h of internal canary. Old frames deprecated 90 days after GA; extended enterprise support up to 6 months available via CS.

Deploy Bot: "canary-start: runtime/v2 -> alpha-cluster at 2045678920"

Rae: Action items: 1) @Leah publish a short timeline + migration checklist by EOD tomorrow. 2) @Nina open SDK PRs and post examples for webhook consumers. 3) @Priya coordinate Dedicated/Private maintenance templates with CS. 4) Product to publish beta invite flow and pilot criteria.

Leah: I'll drop the timeline doc in #eng and update the public roadmap entry.

Priya: I'll draft the Dedicated notice templates and share with CS and Sales.

Nina: Queueing SDK PRs and sample snippets.

Rae: If you asked something during the panel and don't see it answered here, drop it and we'll route to the owner. :thumbsup:
